_about: The diagnostic-code registry (BRIEF sector-idempotency-and-diagnostics, Part B). One entry per stable code: its type (warning, error, notice), its class (advisory or governance), whether a project may suppress it, what it says, and the fix. The getmohio link `mio check` prints and the published reference (tools/diagnostics/build_code_reference.py) derive from this file. tests/test_battery_diagnostics_registry.py fails the build on a code a compiler site uses that is missing here, and on an entry no compiler site uses.

ai_agent_no_not_confident.message: An ai.agent has no `not confident` block, so nothing says what happens when it cannot finish with enough confidence.
ai_agent_no_not_confident.fix: Add a `not confident` block inside the ai.agent.

ai_create_no_failure.message: An ai.create makes a live AI call with no `on.failure`, so a model outage stops the program.
ai_create_no_failure.fix: Add an `on.failure` block inside the ai.create.

ai_decide_audit_order.message: An ai.decide's `ai.audit` line is out of order.
ai_decide_audit_order.fix: Move `ai.audit` to where the message shows.

ai_decide_empty_not_confident.message: An ai.decide's `not confident` block is empty.
ai_decide_empty_not_confident.fix: Say what happens when the decision is not confident.

ai_decide_empty_on_failure.fix: Say what happens when the decision fails.

ai_decide_never_invoked.message: An ai.decide is declared and never invoked, so it never runs and writes no audit entry.
ai_decide_never_invoked.fix: Put its name on a line where the decision belongs, or remove the block.

ai_decide_no_not_confident.message: An ai.decide has no `not confident` block, which is required.

ai_test_asserts_nothing.message: The test file for these ai.decide blocks has no `it` case with an `expect`, so nothing is checked.
ai_test_asserts_nothing.fix: Write an `it` case with an `expect` for each decision.

ai_test_missing.message: These ai.decide blocks have no compliance test file.
ai_test_missing.fix: Create the named test file, or ai.test.mho, with cases for each decision.

bound_unchecked_length.message: A value written in a script breaks a shape's length limit, and only a bound request is checked against it.
bound_unchecked_length.fix: Fix the value, or send it through a request bound to the shape.

bound_unchecked_number.message: A value written in a script breaks a shape's min or max, and only a bound request is checked against it.
bound_unchecked_number.fix: Fix the value, or send it through a request bound to the shape.

check_without_branches.message: A `check` has no `when` and no `otherwise`, so it does nothing.
check_without_branches.fix: Add a `when` or `otherwise` branch, or remove the block.

classification_same_path.message: A journey classifies one path two ways. A warning while you build, an error under a regulated sector.
classification_same_path.fix: Keep the one class line you mean for that path.

classifier_is_override_marker.message: `[important]` on a field does nothing; it marks a journey line that wins over a page.
classifier_is_override_marker.fix: Remove it from the field, and use a real classifier such as `[pii]`.

classifier_is_sec_level.message: A field tag names a `sec.classify` level, which nothing reads on a field, so the field gets no protection.
classifier_is_sec_level.fix: Declare the level in a `sec.classify` block, or use a field classifier.

classifier_unrecognized.message: A field tag is not a recognized classifier, so it applies no protection and the field is stored in the clear.
classifier_unrecognized.fix: Use a recognized classifier, such as `[pii]` or `[phi]`.

client_check_subject_mismatch.message: A client `when` names a different value than its `check`.
client_check_subject_mismatch.fix: Repeat the check's subject in the `when`, or drop it.

cm_action_note.message: This cm action belongs to the commercial runtime and stops the program if it is reached.
cm_action_note.fix: Remove it, or do the work through your own path, until you are on the commercial runtime.

cm_purge_records_only.message: This form of `cm.purge` records an erasure request and deletes nothing.
cm_purge_records_only.fix: To erase rows, name the table and the rows: `cm.purge from db.<table>` with a `match` and a `reason`.

comparison_can_meet_empty.message: A value in a `when` can be empty, and an empty value matches no comparison, so the check goes to `otherwise`.
comparison_can_meet_empty.fix: Guard it with `when <name> is empty` first, or give it a default or make it `required`.

compliance_shape_no_marker.message: The program looks compliance-shaped and carries no compliance marker, so Mohio makes no compliance claim for it.
compliance_shape_no_marker.fix: Declare a sector, or the compliance marker, if this program must be governed.

condition_split.message: A line was read as two conditions, so it does not test what it says.
condition_split.fix: Write one test per `when`, subject first.

connect_default_regulated.message: A `connect` under a sector carries a `default`, which a regulated app never uses.
connect_default_regulated.fix: Remove the default and set the variable to the approved database.

connect_name_twice.message: One name is connected twice to different places.
connect_name_twice.fix: Keep one, or give the second its own name.

connector_retry_changes.message: A connector `retry` covers operations that change something, and they are retried only when the request never left.
connector_retry_changes.fix: Make the operation safe to repeat on the other side, or retry only the reads.

cookie_samesite_none_insecure.message: `same site "none"` without `secure` is a cookie no browser sets.

credential_in_url.message: A connection url in the source carries a password.
credential_in_url.fix: Move the whole url to `env.X` or `secret.X`.

curly_braces_retired.fix: Use named fields, or `as list sh.<Shape>` for nested structures.

dead_store.message: A value is set and never used.
dead_store.fix: Use it, or remove the line.

default_not_on_ungoverned_save.message: A save to a table no shape governs leaves out a field the shape gives a default, so the table gets no value for it.
default_not_on_ungoverned_save.fix: Write the field on the save if the table should hold it.

dynamic_field_assignment.message: A field name is chosen at run, so it cannot be checked here.
dynamic_field_assignment.fix: Make sure the value is a real column name before the line runs.

emit_retired.fix: Rename the variable, or remove the line.

financial_writes_outside_transaction.message: Under a financial sector, several writes are not inside a `transaction`, so a failure partway leaves partial state.
financial_writes_outside_transaction.fix: Wrap writes that belong together in `transaction ... transaction: done`.

HANDLER_CLOSER.message: A handler carries its own closer line, which ends nothing.
HANDLER_CLOSER.fix: Remove the line; a handler ends at the next handler or its block's own closer.

HARDCODED_CREDENTIAL.message: A connect source is a literal string, which hardcodes a credential.

hardcoded_token.message: A signed token is written in the source.

hash_key_from_source.message: `hash ... with key` names a key written as text in the program.
hash_key_from_source.fix: Read the key as a secret: `with key secret.PSI_KEY`.

hash_key_needs_deterministic.message: `with key` is on a salted password hash, which never gives the same token twice.
hash_key_needs_deterministic.fix: Key a deterministic hash (`using sha256 with key ...`), or leave the key off a password hash.

idempotent_route.message: A `once per` line is in the wrong place, is malformed, or keeps its answers for an unusable length.
idempotent_route.fix: Put `once per request.header "Idempotency-Key"` with a `keep for` length at the top of a `listen for` route.

mail_template_quoted.message: A send names its template in quotes.

notify_channel_not_built.message: A `notify` uses a channel other than email, which is not built in this release.
notify_channel_not_built.fix: Send it `via email`, with a `to` line and a `template` (or a `subject` and `message`).

outcome_lookup.message: An `outcome from` lookup is on an operation that changes nothing, names no operation, is not a read, or does not name the call by `{{ key }}`; or a path has braces no lookup fills.
outcome_lookup.fix: On the changing operation write `outcome from findCharge`, and give `findCharge` `method GET` and a path carrying `{{ key }}`.

ignore_inherited.fix: Confirm the suppression is intended; it is logged to the build report.

include_line_emitted_as_text.message: A bare `include` line in a render is shown as text, not run.
include_line_emitted_as_text.fix: Write it as an evaluation, with `include "file"` inside a double-brace pair.

inject_non_fragment.message: `inject` places markup, and its source is a value, not a rendered fragment.
inject_non_fragment.fix: Use `put <value> into <target>` for text, or inject a `render fragment` result.

journey_no_timezone.message: A journey declares no timezone, so its days and shown times are UTC unless MOHIO_APP_TIMEZONE says otherwise.

languages_primary_retired.message: `primary` in a languages block is retired.

match_to_empty_word.message: `match <field> to empty` compares with a value named `empty`, and there is none.

miofile_dangerous_accept.message: A declared file area accepts an executable file type.

miofile_zone_uncovered.message: A miofile path is in no declared area, so the area's `accept` and `max size` rules do not apply.
miofile_zone_uncovered.fix: Move the path inside a declared area, or declare one that covers it.

modifier_not_enforced.message: A field modifier is declared and not enforced in this build.
modifier_not_enforced.fix: Do not rely on it; enforce the rule in the program, or remove it.

modifier_partial.message: A field modifier is enforced on some paths only.
modifier_partial.fix: Read the message for where it is enforced, and cover the rest in the program.

not_a_mohio_word.message: A word from another language reads as an instruction and is a variable name here.
not_a_mohio_word.fix: Use the Mohio form the hint shows.

not_executable.message: A construct parses and is not executable in this build.
not_executable.fix: Remove it, or use the form the message names.

or_if_retired.fix: Use `check / when / otherwise`; `mio fmt` converts it.

orphan_it.message: `it` has no step before it to refer to.
orphan_it.fix: Start a `then` chain, or use a named variable.

page_class_outranked.message: A page declares a looser class than its journey gives its path, so the page's own line does nothing.
page_class_outranked.fix: Classify the page at or above its journey's class for that path.

paginate_without_page_size.message: `paginate by` with no page size would return every row.

password_no_format.message: A password field has no `format "password"`, so a refused form is sent back with the password filled in.

possible_credential.message: A value in the source looks like a key.

possible_event_typo.message: A browser event name is one letter off from a real one, so the handler never triggers.

possible_typo.message: A line is one letter off from a verb, so it parsed as an assignment and the verb never happens.
possible_typo.fix: Correct the verb, or rename the variable.

private_key_in_source.message: A private key is written in the source.

refuse_after_unwrapped_write.message: A handler writes and can still refuse afterwards, outside a transaction, so the refusal answers with the row already saved.
refuse_after_unwrapped_write.fix: Check before writing, or wrap the write and the check in one `transaction`.

regulated_field_needs_type.message: A classified field has no declared type, and regulated data is never inferred.
regulated_field_needs_type.fix: Declare its type, for example `<name> as text [pii]`.

release_never_held.message: `release` names a value that is never held, so it does nothing.
release_never_held.fix: Hold the value where it is set, or remove the release.

reserved_namespace_name.message: `env`, `secret` or `hide` is bound as a name; each is reserved (`env.X`, `secret.X`, the `[hide]` tag).
reserved_namespace_name.fix: Name the value for what it holds, for example `env_value`.

require_device_permission.message: A device `require` is declared and not built yet.
require_device_permission.fix: Gate the handler with `require role "..."` for now.

role_unquoted.message: A role value is not in quotes.

route_retired.fix: Write a handler on its own: `request for sh.X at /path`, or `listen for sh.X at /path`.

scanner_crashed.message: A check scanner crashed, so its findings for this run are missing. This is a compiler bug.
scanner_crashed.fix: Report the bug, naming the scanner.

script_in_render.message: A render carries script, and a render is for markup only.
script_in_render.fix: Put JavaScript in `render scripts`, or use MioScript.

sector_audit_grade_required.message: The sector requires a grade of audit storage that the deployment must bind.
sector_audit_grade_required.fix: Bind an audit sink that meets the grade.

sector_audit_grade_unknown.message: The sector names a framework with no known audit grade, which would be read as requiring nothing.
sector_audit_grade_unknown.fix: Correct the framework name, or add it to the framework table.

sector_base_unrecognized.message: The sector base is not recognized.
sector_base_unrecognized.fix: Use a known base, or provide a matching `.sector` profile.

sector_certified_not_installed.message: The sector names a certified profile that is not installed, so its rules are not applied.
sector_certified_not_installed.fix: Install the certified profile, or run the licensed runtime.

sector_community_profile.message: The sector uses a community or unverified profile.
sector_community_profile.fix: Use an official profile for production compliance.

SECTOR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR.message: An ai.decide confidence is below the sector's floor.
SECTOR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR.fix: Raise the confidence to the floor, or mark the decision `sec.non_critical reason "..."`.

sector_idempotency_key_required.message: Declaring a sector makes each route that moves value (writes an amount, or sends one out) require an `Idempotency-Key` header; a caller that sends none is refused 400. The notice is advisory: the 400 is never suppressed.
sector_idempotency_key_required.fix: Update the callers to send a new key per request and the same key to retry, then record it in the journey with `suppress sector_idempotency_key_required reason "<why>"`; or write `not idempotent reason "<why>"` on a route that should not require one.

sector_level_message.message: A level of the sector declaration has no profile, so it adds no rules.
sector_level_message.fix: Install the level's profile, or remove the level.

sector_name_format.message: No profile matches the sector, so no sector rules are applied.
sector_name_format.fix: Correct the sector name; the message names the nearest installed profile.

SECTOR_NEVER_STORE.message: A field the sector classifies as never-store is stored.

sector_route_not_idempotent.message: Routes under a sector change something without moving value, and are not made idempotent.
sector_route_not_idempotent.fix: Add `once per request.header "Idempotency-Key"` to any that should answer a repeat from the first answer.

sector_route_unauthenticated.message: A route reads data under a sector with nothing checking who asks.
sector_route_unauthenticated.fix: Gate it with `authorize:`, or declare it `public:` in the journey.

sector_unmaintained.message: The sector profile is certified and not actively maintained.
sector_unmaintained.fix: Check it against current regulations before deployment.

sector_webhook_unverified.message: Under a sector, an inbound request is accepted with nothing proving who sent it.

shape_may_not_loosen_sector.message: A shape drops a classification the sector requires.
shape_may_not_loosen_sector.fix: Write every classification the sector gives the field.

subjectless_condition.message: A `when` puts the test before its subject.
subjectless_condition.fix: Name the subject first, then the test.

success_on_possibly_empty_lookup.message: `on.success` runs when a lookup finds no row, so the value may be empty inside it.

suppress_line.message: A journey's `suppress` line names no code, an error, a governance code, has no reason, or repeats a code.
suppress_line.fix: Suppress an advisory code, with a reason: `suppress <code> reason "<why>"`.

task_answer_discarded.message: A call drops the answer its task gives back.

task_closer_named.message: A task closer names the task.
task_closer_named.fix: Close it with `task: done`; `mio fmt` converts it.

template_display_block.message: A `template` has a `display` block, which belongs to a `view`.

template_line_repeated.message: A `template` says the same line twice, so one of the two would be ignored.
template_line_repeated.fix: Keep one of the two lines.

template_nothing_to_send.message: A `template` has no `body`, `html` file or `text` file.

template_two_text_bodies.message: A `template` has both `body` and a `text` file, two plain-text versions of one message.
template_two_text_bodies.fix: Keep `body` or the `text` file; `html` goes alongside either.

token_form.message: A token verb is written in a form that refuses: a missing expiry, scope or use limit, or an action in a GET.
token_form.fix: Use the form the message shows.

transaction_onfailure_success.message: An `on.failure` inside a transaction answers success after the writes were rolled back.
transaction_onfailure_success.fix: Answer the failure, or put the success after `transaction: done`.

try_without_failure.message: A `try` has no `on.failure`, so it catches nothing.

type_label_does_not_convert.message: A type label on an assignment does not convert the value.
type_label_does_not_convert.fix: Cast in the value, for example `as.int`.

typo_declared_never_read.message: One name is never declared and a near one is declared and never read: usually one typo.

undeclared_name.message: A line reads a name nothing in the program declares.
undeclared_name.fix: Declare the name, or correct it.

unique_governs_no_table.message: `unique` on a shape that is never written to a table does nothing.
unique_governs_no_table.fix: Remove `unique`, or write the shape to a table.

unknown_render_kind.message: The word after `render` is not a render kind.
unknown_render_kind.fix: Write `render`, `render scripts` or `render code`, or move the content to the next line.

upload_local_disk.message: Uploaded files go to local disk, which some hosts reset on restart or redeploy.
upload_local_disk.fix: Point MOHIO_UPLOAD_DIR at durable storage, or use a cloud upload store.

UPLOAD_SIZE.message: An upload field allows a large file.

webhook_freshness_absent.message: A webhook verifies its signature with no freshness window, so a delivery signed long ago is accepted.
webhook_freshness_absent.fix: Add a freshness bound to the `verify signature` line.

webhook_secret_rotation.message: A webhook secret rotation is malformed.
webhook_secret_rotation.fix: Use the form the message shows.

webhook_unverified.message: An inbound route accepts a request with nothing proving who sent it. An error under a regulated sector.
webhook_unverified.fix: Add `verify signature using env.<SECRET>`, or `require role "..."`.

while_no_exit.message: A `while` loop has no visible exit and may run forever.
while_no_exit.fix: Make the condition become false, or add a `stop`.

claim_result_unread.message: An update claims a field only where it is empty, and nothing reads whether it did.
claim_result_unread.fix: Name the count with `update db.x as claimed` and branch on it with `check claimed`.
